subject: Intro & walkthrough request from Marketplace listing (GreenTrail)
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie@greentrail.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick intro + product walkthrough? (GreenTrail inquiry via AWS Marketplace)

Hi Ben,

We filed an inquiry through your AWS Marketplace listing earlier this week and I completed a short self-serve signup to kick the tires. I'm the product lead at GreenTrail Analytics (we build supply-chain forecasting for food retailers). We're evaluating inference platforms to replace a home-grown LLM endpoint — main asks are predictable latency with batching and private deployment options for sensitive datasets.

Would love a 30-minute walkthrough of Redwood to see how it fits. Our team prefers mornings PST; I'm available Tue/Wed next week between 9–11am PT. Can you include someone to speak to integration/ingestion (SAML, S3 connectors)?

A few quick context points:
- We ingested ~12M rows/month, typical prompt lengths ~1k tokens
- P0: low variance latency at 99th pct
- Interested in Dedicated or Private deployment pricing ranges

Thanks — attaching a tiny CSV with anonymized traffic shape.

Sophie Turner
Product Lead, GreenTrail Analytics
Sophie Turner <sophie@greentrail.io>
Attachment: GreenTrail-quick-metrics.csv (csv)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@greentrail.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro + product walkthrough? (GreenTrail inquiry via AWS Marketplace)

Hi Sophie — thanks for reaching out and for the context + CSV. This is a great fit for a short intro so we can map use-case to deployment options. Monica (cc'd) is our solutions engineer and can cover SAML/S3 integration and the Dedicated/Private trade-offs.

Would any of these slots work for a 30-minute walkthrough?
- Tue Dec 1, 9:30–10:00am PT
- Tue Dec 1, 10:30–11:00am PT
- Wed Dec 2, 9:00–9:30am PT

If none of those are good, here's a quick Calendly link to pick a time: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo?slot=GT-3442

Agenda (30 min):
1) 10 min — GreenTrail goals + constraints
2) 10 min — Redwood demo: latency, batching, Dedicated vs Private
3) 5 min — next steps & pricing/POC options
4) 5 min — ops/security questions (Monica)

I'll prepare a short demo tailored to your token lengths and the attached sample. If you want us to demo a Private deployment workflow or show a dedicated latency trace, let us know.

Best,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Sophie
